images.prompt: Empty vertical street photograph in a quiet old European city street (London/Paris style), shot straight on from the middle of a narrow cobbled-asphalt road toward one building facade. The facade: a warm brown brick upper floor with white sash windows and window boxes of small green plants, and a ground-floor shopfront painted deep bottle-green with gold trim, large paned glass windows, a dark wooden door with brass handle, a single brass wall lantern. The shop sign board is completely blank with no letters. Pale stone sidewalk with a curb, grey asphalt road in the foreground with a faded white road line. Overcast soft daylight, slightly moody muted colors, cinematic 35mm film look. No people, no cars, no text, no letters, no logos, no signage words.
